scope: Additive whole-field identifier recognition; historical v5 evaluation remains unchanged

short_whole_field_identifier.source: complete mapped reference or movement_number field only
short_whole_field_identifier.form: alphanumeric segments separated optionally by hyphen, slash or period; at least one letter and digit
short_whole_field_identifier.comparison: case-normalized complete value with punctuation preserved
short_whole_field_identifier.never_promote: short fragments of free text, bare numeric values or generic period labels

reason: The previous extracted-token length guard incorrectly discarded complete explicitly mapped identifiers such as C101, preventing exact conserved split groups
regression_requirements: Exact short mixed alphanumeric whole-field references conserve grouped amounts
Preserve punctuation and distinguish A-1 from A1
Do not promote bare numeric, generic period or short free-text fragments
